newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RBA makes no announcement on Australian rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RBA makes no announcement on Australian rates.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) made no annoucement on official cash rates in its 9.30 a.m. (2330 GMT) market operation annoucement on Friday.
There had been speculation in financial markets that the central bank would cut rates as early as this morning following favourable Australian wages and inflation data this week.

Most market analysts still expect the bank to ease policy before year-end, possibly after its next board meeting on November 5. The official cash rate currently stands at 7.0 percent, having been cut by 0.5 point on July 31.
